# DHNT

> DHNT turns the computers you already own into one self-hostable, agent-operable mesh. Pages serve HTML by default, Markdown with `Accept: text/markdown` or at their `.md` twin, and JSON at their `.json` twin; cite `page#section @ revision`.

## Pages

- [Home](/): what DHNT is and how to start
- [About](/about): about, team and contact sections
